set.body:
Goal
Reduce dependence on entropic smoothing and provide a measurable optimization certificate for the non-convex fixed-mass objective.

Implementation
Use the stable entropic solution as initialization, then apply fixed-mass conditional-gradient or Frank-Wolfe updates with deterministic line search. Evaluate a mature external implementation such as POT only as an optional differential oracle, not a required runtime dependency.

Acceptance criteria
- The solver reports objective trace, feasibility residuals, coverage, and a stationarity or conditional-gradient gap.
- The polished objective is no worse than its initialization under the same frozen estimand.
- Multiple structural starts produce stable energy, coverage, warp, barycentric correspondence, and candidate rank; elementwise coupling equality is not required.
- Candidate order is permuted in invariance tests.
- Entropic-only, polished, and reference-oracle results are compared on a fixed fixture bank.
- The default changes only if polish improves numerical/scientific stability without unacceptable runtime; otherwise the backend remains an audit option with a documented no-go result.
set.title: GW-18.6 Add a conditional-gradient scientific-polish solver and oracle court
